name: IC Power Converter — buck, 18V — Converter
description: Cluster of 3 through-hole buck IC power converter parts rated for 18V using Murata NCS1SxxxxSC and RECOM R-78E-0.5 THT footprints.
selection_hints: Select for 18V buck IC power converter applications requiring through-hole mounting.
Match target footprints to Converter_DCDC_Murata_NCS1SxxxxSC_THT or Converter_DCDC_RECOM_R-78E-0.5_THT.
Choose from tier A parts including NCS1S1205SC, NCS1S1212SC, and R-781.8-1.0.
avoid_when: Surface-mount (SMD) mounting is required instead of through-hole.
The design requires converter topologies other than buck or ratings other than 18V.
The PCB layout requires packages other than the supported Murata or RECOM THT footprints.
